summary: Messages Nora reads back with load_transcript or room_read now say when they were sent, as a date, weekday and time with how long ago, instead of a raw number she could not read as a time.
details: An edited message says when it was edited the same way.
room_list gives the time a room last spoke in the same form.
limitations: She still reads only the most recent messages of a room (up to 60); reading from an earlier time is the next change.
